feature: Run controls: the run page runs the controller's own recovery and decision commands as the operator, behind pairing, origin, host and stale-state guards, and shows their progress and result

scenarios.description: With run controls off (the API started without MD_MANAGER_RUN_CONTROLS=on), a run page that waits on a stopped supervisor looks exactly as today: the dock's command block has Copy and no Run button, its caption still says the viewer never changes a run, there is no Controls button in the identity line, and no request goes to /api/run-controls/* other than the status probe

With controls on and no token in this browser, the identity line's Controls button opens a 'Pair this browser' panel with one token field and nothing else; a wrong token says it was refused and asks again; the right token closes the panel and the Controls list appears; after a reload the browser is still paired; the token is never shown again on the page

On an automatic run whose supervisor stopped (an interrupted event naming automatic --live), the dock's command block shows Run beside Copy on the restart command; Run opens a confirmation dialog with the label 'Restart supervisor', the exact redacted command, what it does and what it does not do; Confirm sends one POST (a second click while it is in flight sends nothing); the dock then shows a Controls row 'Restart supervisor' running with its log tail behind a disclosure, then succeeded; Escape closes the dialog without sending and focus returns to Run

On a run whose supervisor is running, the Controls list shows Pause supervisor available and Restart supervisor, Retry a check, Reconcile launches, Abandon and Clean greyed with the reason 'A supervisor is running' (with since time); Pause's confirmation says the workers keep running; on a finished run Clean is available and Restart is greyed with a reason

On a run where lane ui waits on question 2 and has a pane recorded in terminals.json, the Controls list and the dock offer Answer the question; its dialog shows the question text and a text field; Confirm stays disabled while the field is empty; an answer is sent once and the record shows succeeded with the controller's output line

Abandon the run asks for a reason and the run id typed: Confirm stays disabled until the typed id matches exactly; Approve and integrate, Repair a lane and Clean worktrees ask for the typed run id the same way; Clean first shows the dry-run output it will act on

A control the controller refuses (the fake controller prints 'Blocked: ...' and exits 1) shows the record as failed with the Blocked line first; a request answered 409 STATE_CHANGED says the run changed since you looked and refreshes the controls, without sending again; a 409 BUSY says another control of this run is running

At 390 px wide: the Controls list is a bottom sheet, every control's button and reason are readable without horizontal scroll, the confirmation dialog fits the screen with its command wrapped, and nothing on the run page scrolls sideways
